heading: Matching
text:
### Matching [LTSL.4.2]

In `produces` assertions and `for call` keys a fact is **matched** in DS pattern
style. A bare head with slot arguments is **partial (subset) equality** —
`emitted HeaterOn zone: "cellar"` matches any `HeaterOn` whose `zone` is
`"cellar"`, other slots free. A `where` clause — on the `emitted`
head ([LTSL.8.4]) — is a full DS predicate — `emitted TempReading t where
t.celsius > 40` — that binds the matched fact and evaluates the expression surface
([LEXP]); the predicate lowers to the same `Expr` trees a rule's own `where`
lowers to ([RDSC.4a.9]).
